name: Manifestation of Y'Shaarj uses its own display, not Herald of the Depths (#9105)
contract: Dark Calling (560715) spawns three entry-397771 'Manifestation of Y''Shaarj' creatures on the Cultist, named correctly, but creature_template_model pointed them at display 28844, the Herald of the Depths/FacelessOne transform display (rev_20261022_13_cultist_herald_display.sql), reading as a massive monster rather than the tooltip's small adds. Two independent client captures (conquest-of-azeroth, 2026-08-06 and 2026-09-04) and the Exiles DB export (db.exil.es/npc/397771) all name entry 397771's own display as 427990. This checks the corrected display directly against creature_template_model, independent of Dark Calling's 35%-health/2-minute proc gate.
